answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via barometric infrasound attestation. Nodes broadcast ambient pressure waveforms sampled from physical sensors across varied topography, such as a mountain summit, a stone terrace, or a low meadow. Attackers must deploy scarce, geographically dispersed physical barometers to capture unpredictable atmospheric turbulence per identity. However, indoor HVAC dampening attenuates pressure variations, causing false rejections.
